question: Estimate the size of the gaming-PC / high-end PC gamer segment in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: PC gamers with rigs valued ₹1L+ (high-end gaming setups)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total PC gamer base × high-end share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian PC gamers (all): ~12-15M (mostly cafe gamers, casual).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: High-end gaming PC owners (₹1L+ rig): ~5-7% of personal gaming PCs = ~200K-250K.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus 'aspiring' segment buying mid-high rigs (₹70K-₹1L): ~400K additional.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual high-end PC + accessory spend: ~₹150-200K per active enthusiast.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus streamers / professional gamers with high-end rigs

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~2-3 lakh true high-end PC gamers in India.

calculationFlow: High-end gaming PC owners (₹1L+ rig): ~5-7% of personal gaming PCs = ~200K-250K.
Plus 'aspiring' segment buying mid-high rigs (₹70K-₹1L): ~400K additional.
Round: ~2-3 lakh true high-end PC gamers in India.
Annual high-end PC + accessory spend: ~₹150-200K per active enthusiast.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~2-3 lakh true high-end PC gamers in India.
